general_background.title: Alkalinity changes dissolved growth species
general_background.summary: Sodium hydroxide can change which soluble hydroxide complexes exist during hydrothermal growth. That shifts the balance between dissolution and precipitation and can change the phase that crystallizes.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

general_background.title: A hydrophilic thiol can cap hydrothermal dots
general_background.summary: In aqueous hydrothermal cadmium telluride growth, an acetylated cysteine ligand can bind surface cadmium through sulfur. Its water-compatible groups help stabilize the dispersed particles after growth.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
